prompts.oud-mirage:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE square 1:1 high-resolution finished website packshot, realistic commercial studio photograph. Input 1 is authoritative six-canister photo, input2 is actual three matching bottle/open-package photo, input3 is authoritative closeup of three complete capped bottles. Input4 is the approved MOJITO METALLIQUE clean-cream website packshot, for composition/framing/lighting reference ONLY. Match input4 precisely in framing, relative product size, soft shadows and cream background. DO NOT copy its yellow identity or white labels.
Composition: exactly one upright capped bottle in front-left and its one CLOSED cylindrical canister beside and slightly behind at right. Whole bottle and closed canister with generous margins like input4. Cylindrical clear glass bottle, thick clear-glass base, tall glossy black cylindrical cap, narrow silver collar, original authentic proportions. Canister slightly taller and wider than capped bottle, black top/bottom rims, low sleeve join. Both existing BLACK front labels face the camera, fully visible with white serif scent name and original small monogram/PARFUM/LONDON printing with fine rules. Preserve all printed details without inventing or overlaying extra branding.
Backdrop: ONLY seamless warm cream #f4e3cb wall and same matte cream tabletop. Neutral-warm soft studio light, grounded shadow, clean glass reflections. NO plinth/platform, chrome ribbon, arch, leaves, blocks, props, gradients, fabric, other products, people, headline, badge or watermark. Opaque photograph.
SUBJECT: OUD MIRAGE only. In input1 fourth canister from left (muted medium blue); in input2 center pair; in input3 rightmost bottle. Matching muted medium-blue cylindrical canister, BLACK label. Liquid is transparent PALE BLUE with very subtle lilac cast, not saturated cyan or turquoise. Match the pale transparent bottle appearance in input3; do not turn the package's stronger blue into the liquid color. Existing labels must say "OUD MIRAGE" on one line, in authentic white serif letters. Preserve monogram, PARFUM, LONDON exactly.
